m - water depth of the chunk cell under the figure (GIS_HYD_CELL_DEPTH), never negative

Runtime metric: the world height in metres of the stem foot of a body, the origin of its frame (per body owner: the entity named in the flatten row HUB_TERN_MUT_REQ_BODY; usecase:5939 - adapt area terrain), set by TerrainHubFlatPubSystem once the order is applied. ase-gis does not read it: the levelled cells reach the grid through HUB_TERN_MCRO (CAUSA_ASE_GIS B0542). Readers: PhysicsHubGrndSyncSystem (ase-physics, usecase:100708) takes it as origin_y of PhysicsInpOwnrFrmComponent; RadixHubFrmSyncSystem (ase-radix, usecase:6459) as origin_y of RadixInpFrmComponent on a patch; FloraHubFlatSyncSystem (ase-pl-flora, usecase:100387) as the level of FloraInpFlatComponent on a patch; PlayerAreaSynSystem (ase-player, usecase:101612) reads it on the area plate of a figure (HUB_PLR_AREA_PLATE) into PlayerInpAreaComponent.level; CameraAreaSynSystem (ase-camera, usecase:101612) reads it on the area plate of the followed figure and keeps the player camera above it. NO GROUND: a body stands on the ase-gis elevation cells (the HeightMapShape3D of the Godot client), never on this value. 0.0 is a height, so a reader asks is_measured first. Value 0.0.

Runtime metric: the world place of the stem foot of a body, metres east, the origin of its frame (per body owner, the same owner as TRN_FLAT_HGT; usecase:5939 - adapt area terrain), set by TerrainHubFlatPubSystem together with TRN_FLAT_HGT. Readers: PhysicsHubGrndSyncSystem (ase-physics, usecase:100708, origin_x of PhysicsInpOwnrFrmComponent); RadixHubFrmSyncSystem (ase-radix, usecase:6459, origin_x of RadixInpFrmComponent); PlayerAreaSynSystem (ase-player, usecase:101612, PlayerInpAreaComponent.x on the area plate); PhytomerHubLocSyncSystem (ase-phytomer, usecase:3245, PhytomerInpLocComponent.east of the shoot, read by PhytomerPolnCalcSystem and PhytomerFertCalcSystem for the distance between mother and father). 0.0 is a place, so a reader asks is_measured first. Value 0.0.

Runtime metric: the world place of the stem foot of a body, metres north, the origin of its frame (per body owner, the same owner as TRN_FLAT_HGT; usecase:5939 - adapt area terrain), set by TerrainHubFlatPubSystem together with TRN_FLAT_HGT. Readers: PhysicsHubGrndSyncSystem (ase-physics, usecase:100708, origin_z of PhysicsInpOwnrFrmComponent); RadixHubFrmSyncSystem (ase-radix, usecase:6459, origin_z of RadixInpFrmComponent); PlayerAreaSynSystem (ase-player, usecase:101612, PlayerInpAreaComponent.z on the area plate); PhytomerHubLocSyncSystem (ase-phytomer, usecase:3245, PhytomerInpLocComponent.north of the shoot, read by PhytomerPolnCalcSystem and PhytomerFertCalcSystem for the distance between mother and father). 0.0 is a place, so a reader asks is_measured first. Value 0.0.
